title: AI-Assisted Coding
description: AAIRO – AI-Assisted Coding is a hybrid, AI-driven coding competition designed to introduce students to modern AI-assisted development workflows. The event emphasizes creativity, experimentation, and intelligent collaboration with AI tools while maintaining a structured competitive framework.

title: N8N Automation Challenge
description: AAIRO proposes to organize a hands-on AI & Automation Competition using n8n, where students will design and deploy real-world automation workflows within a limited time.
